meta.name: ai-research-explore
meta.description: Rigor Explore compatible skill slug for meaningful and potentially novel deep learning research candidates. Use when the researcher has chosen the task family, dataset, benchmark, evaluation method, provided SOTA references, and wants candidate-only exploration on top of `current_research` with auditable repo understanding, idea gating, fair comparison, and governed experiments written to `explore_outputs/`. Do not use for README-first trusted reproduction, open-ended direction finding, narrow code-only or run-only exploration, passive repo analysis, verified novelty claims, or implicit experimentation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对已定研究任务筛出有潜力的新点子并公平对比
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果已选好研究任务和评测基准,想在投入前筛选创新方案。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a chosen research setup and need to vet novel ideas fairly before committing.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 在深度学习研究课题上做候选方案探索：把你想试的新点子整理成独立候选，逐个评估可行性后运行小规模实验，记录实际证据和排名，并把实验日志与对比报告写入输出目录，辅助你做下一步决定。
howto.when: 当你明确说想只试几个候选方向（例如“比较这几种变体”或“跑几组小实验”），并且已经确定了任务、数据集、评估方法和参照基线时触发；还需要有一个已存在的代码分支、检查点或已训练模型作为起点。

say.text: 帮我在当前基线上试两个候选：加dropout还是调学习率，先都做可行性评估。
say.note: 会对两个想法先打分排序。

say.text: 按我们已确定的任务和数据，设计一组每次只改一个变量的候选方案并排序。
say.note: 输出带评分筛选的候选清单。

howto.what_en: This skill structures candidate-only deep learning exploration. It converts ideas into separate candidates, checks feasibility, runs small trials, records evidence, and writes logs and comparison reports to output dirs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explicitly ask for candidate-only exploration (e.g., compare variants, run a sweep), with task, dataset, eval, and SOTA reference already frozen, and an existing code/checkpoint as anchor.

say_en.text: Try two candidates: add dropout vs change LR; first check feasibility.
Design and rank single-variable candidates under our fixed task and data.
Turn all candidate changes/results into a comparison report in explore_outputs.
